description: DevOps / platform engineering role with cloud and container skills

input.jobDescription:
DevOps Engineer at MegaCorp

MegaCorp's Platform Engineering team is seeking a DevOps Engineer to manage and evolve our cloud infrastructure serving millions of users.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design and maintain Kubernetes clusters on AWS EKS
- Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and Jenkins
- Manage infrastructure as code with Terraform and Helm
- Monitor systems with Prometheus, Grafana, and PagerDuty
- Drive incident response and postmortems

Required:
- Kubernetes administration (CKA preferred)
- Docker containerization
- AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC)
- Terraform
- Strong Linux/bash scripting
- CI/CD pipeline design

Desired:
- Istio service mesh
- Vault for secrets management

Location: San Francisco, CA or Remote. Apply at megacorp.com/careers
